preprocessing.eeg: scipy.signal.decimate(x, 5, ftype='fir', zero_phase=True) -> 17 x 300 at 100 Hz, full 0-3000 ms
preprocessing.normalisation: per-subject per-channel z-score; mean/std over (recordings, time) of that subject's fit-train recordings only; applied unchanged to test EEG
preprocessing.test_row_order: file order of tst/sub-XX_tst.npy, never sorted

decoder.architecture: src.eeg_encoder.EEGNetEncoder(f1=16, depth=2, f2=32, kernel=25, embed_dim=128, n_subjects=6) + VideoHead(768 -> 128)
decoder.training_data: all organizer training recordings of sub-01..sub-06 (trn/ only)

early_stopping.metric: mean per-subject retrieval MRR among inner-validation training videos

decoder.scoring: cosine similarity of L2-normalised EEG and candidate embeddings
decoder.seed_ensemble: mean over seeds of per-row z-scored scores

model_c.implementation: src.final_model.FrozenModelC fitted on all training recordings of each subject
